messages:
elaine: Quick sync: we need to prioritize Console visibility features for Q2. Proposal: a tiny dashboard tile 'Visibility Snapshot' (cost sparkline, error hotspots, trace link). Pilots only.

raj: +1. What's in-scope for MVP vs later? We should be strict.

sofia: MVP suggestion: (A) per-route cost estimate (top 5 routes), (B) simple error count + spike detection, (C) single-click link to trace view. Stretch: per-tenant rollups, request fingerprint grouping, and pin/comparison UI.

michael: Telemetry ops note: tracing every request is a hard no. We need event-driven sampling rules and a low-overhead trace pointer emitted only on triggered samples.

ops-anna: Agree. Also need safety nets: default retention 3-7 days, and a telemetry budget guardrail (percent of network/ingest).

elaine: Proposed launch gates: 1) UI shows top-5 cost routes and error rate within 2 clicks; 2) trace link resolves to a sample span with request_id and tenant; 3) canary run (5% traffic) with no >1.5x error increase and p95 latency delta <25ms; 4) telemetry spend delta < +8% for a medium workload; 5) pilot feedback from 3 customers.

raj: Add rollout step: feature flag + tenant opt-in. Start with internal and 2 pilot customers, then expand. Prioritization: core visibility tile Q2 sprint 1, sampling rules Q2 sprint 2, per-tenant rollups Q3.

sofia: UX point: keep the tile tiny. Show two sparklines (cost / errors), a hotlist of 3 contributors with a chevron to open detailed pane. Settings should hide advanced sampling controls behind an "Advanced" link.

jamie-sales: For pilots I can line up: FinApps (enterprise), HealthSaaS (HIPAA), and StartupX (PLG). They care about per-tenant cost and quick root-cause links.

michael: Implementation sketch: runtime emits a compact sample header when sampling rule fires: X-RW-SAMPLE-ID: <id>. Backend sampling controller evaluates streaming counters and pushes sampling decision via config service. No full-span unless sampled.

ops-anna: Example sampling policy draft:
```
policies:
  - id: err_spike
    when: errors_per_minute(route) > 5
    sample_pct: 50
  - id: high_token
    when: tokens_per_minute(route) > 20000
    sample_pct: 5
budget_pct: 8
retention_days: 7
```

elaine: Nice. Let's also define acceptance metrics we track during canary: p95 latency, error_ratio, telemetry_ingest_bytes, cost_delta. Add OK/Fail thresholds next to each in the PRD.

raj: On prioritization tradeoffs: if infra ETA slips, we can ship a read-only "cost+errors" tile that links to existing logs for traces — lower value but still useful. That could unblock customers while runtime work finishes.

sofia: Agree — fallback path reduces risk. We should document UX differences clearly so pilot customers know sampling isn't live initially.

michael: ETA: sampling controller + header hook is ~3 sprints; low-effort fallback (UI + log links) is 2 weeks. Depends on priority.

ops-anna: Ops checklist for canary: alert on telemetry budget breach, automated rollback on >1.5x error increase, and an on-call runbook. I'll draft.

deploy-bot: canary deployed: visibility-snapshot-v1 -> namespace=pilot traffic=5% (30m monitor window).

elaine: Next steps: (1) raj + michael spec canary checks & sampling API; (2) sofia deliver 2 mocks: full and fallback; (3) jamie to confirm pilot customers; (4) ops-anna to draft canary runbook. I'll assemble a short PRD and circulate by Wed. :spiral_calendar: 

raj: One more ask: include a simple telemetry cost estimator in the UI (projected bytes and cost for 7-day retention at current sampling rates). Customers keep asking "how much will this cost?"

sofia: Good idea — put it in advanced settings as a calculator with sliders for sample rate + retention.

elaine: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the PRD. Keep the thread for quick follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
